title: Halden's Records
summary: Halden wants the outpost that bought Ashford's men burned to the ground.

dialogue.intro: The one with gold under its banner. Nearest one, I'd wager.
dialogue.reward: Then Ashford's debt is paid in their coin.
offer: The one with gold under its banner. Nearest one, I'd wager.
Emptied, then. I'm not a cruel man.
